notes.title: Sequel announced! It's an FPS Game!??
notes.notes:
That's right! After over 2 years since the steam release of this game, I'm proud to finally say that a sequel that continues right where this game left off is set to release in just a few months! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2477140/Twilight_Town_A_Cyberpunk_FPS/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40037202/3e0a1e6b249c1236627e9fdaaa092a5f33f98c18.gif[/img]
As you can see, instead of it being a visual novel, it's an FPS game! What's up with that? 

Making a sequel to twilight town has always been in the back of my head, as a matter of fact, I wrote pages and pages of potential scenes and dialogue that would go into a sequel, I would even scout for artists who could closely replicate the beautiful style of this game. So trust me when I say that I have a deep respect for this game and I do want to give this the conclusion it deserves! 

Along the way, I made an FPS game that was very fun to make and despite a few hurdles, proved to be very successful and was received very well among fans! 

I decided that FPS games would be the direction my games take, at least for a little bit, but of course, I still always wanted to make a sequel to twilight town! 

So naturally i thought I could make a sequel to twilight town while still retaining the direction I wanted to take for my new games, the result was a twilight town FPS game! 

Making the sequel into an FPS game was not a decision took lightly, I understand that change in genre might be drastic, and due to the nature of it being an FPS game, the story line might take a backseat, but rest assured 

[b]The game will be amazing[/b]

[b]Beloved characters like Ikuro and the girl WILL return[/b]

[b]There will be a lot of charming and funny dialogue just like from the first game![/b]

[b]The story from the first game WILL finally have it's conclusion[/b]

I have most of the gameplay mechanics implemented and I can promise it's a lot of fun! 

I hope you all look forward to the sequel coming out in September, be sure to wishlist it if you're interested! 

Thank you and have a wonderful day!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2477140/Twilight_Town_A_Cyberpunk_FPS/

notes.title: 日本語のローカライズが完了しました！| Japanese Translation Is Here!
notes.notes:

notes.title: Future of the game + Soundtrack Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I'm very happy to see the reception for this game has been very positive, as a matter of fact, it's been so positive that almost everyone seems want a sequel to the game! And my answer to that is this:

I would LOVE to make a sequel to the game, however, as I'm sure you can guess, due to the assets in the game, such as the art and music being extremely high quality, a sequel would not be cheap to make. The game would need enough sales/popularity to justify spending the funds + time on a sequel. So you can further help the future of the game by buying the soundtrack, writing reviews, recommending it to friends, etc. 

As a bonus, here is a piece of unused art that will be used in the sequel if there will be one! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40037202/35a081677e14bc54f6e6137a41856c0dec90367e.png[/img]

If for whatever reason we don't meet the demands for a more expansive sequel.  I am still open to making a continuation of the story, however it would have to obviously be cut down and re-use assets from the game (basically it would just be a sort of "extended" version of the base game sold as DLC).

So yeah! I would be most greatful if you all would continue to show your support for the game, such as by buying the newly released soundtrack or gifting it to a friend, etc. 

Purchase the soundtrack here (you don't need to own TT to own the OST):

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1625660/Twilight_Town_A_Cyberpunk_Day_In_Life_Soundtrack/
